about: Milliseconds per run of rxbench.nim (nimaki's wrapper over the regex library) on a text of 4,000 lines, 129,780 bytes, in C and in JavaScript (Node 22), and of native.js (the same patterns on JavaScript's own RegExp), on the 4-core sandbox, 14 November 2026. 'patched' is the JavaScript build with pstate.patch applied to a scratch copy of the library, never committed. The JavaScript numbers are the mean of two runs.

rows.case: a g walk with two groups (matchAll)
a lexer: a sticky match at every token

quadratic.about: Milliseconds for one s.match(re) over a date format of n tokens ('D ' n times), the token pattern of dayjs with its three groups and without them, in C and in JavaScript.
